cohort.label: GEMINI_MUTATION_COHORT_V1
cohort.note: Window 02 of 10 under OWNER-2026-09-21-GEMINI-BTC15M-Q1-CAP4-COHORT-1. Spec btc15m_q1_cap4_w60_880, spec_sha 223b81ed..., quote interval TTE [60,880]; envelope GEMINI_L5_LIVE_ENVELOPE_Q1_BTC15M_CAP4_V1 UNCHANGED (q=1, cap 4, $4.00 committed, $4.00 residual, 2 working orders, 1 rung per outcome). EXACTLY 12 action attempts for THIS window; the cohort's ten ledgers are 120 and no more can be minted. Each records the pre-cohort state (CAP4-3's ledger) rather than the window before it, because a linked list would read a previous window SPENDING ITS BUDGET as tampering and stop a cohort the owner authorized. No reset, no replenishment, no rollover between windows, no eleventh window.
cohort.labels: the cohort budget is a TIGHTENING of the envelope, never an extension of it. No rollover, no automatic successor.
